item.title: Incarico post-doc: Evolution of Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) schemes and packaging producers’ obligations across EU Member States following Regulation (EU) 2025/40: comparative analysis, producer fees and recovery and recycling performance. (Univ. TUSCIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. TUSCIA, Viterbo
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-10 Scienze merceologiche

The position is part of a European-scale research project co-funded by CONAI under the Implementing Agreement of 10/09/2026, aimed at updating CONAI’s “Packaging for Europe – P4EU” portal and at producing information notes for companies. The entry into force of Regulation (EU) 2025/40 (PPWR) requires Member States to adapt their packaging management models – EPR schemes and the related Producer Responsibility Organisations (PROs), deposit return systems (DRS) and tax systems – with direct implications for the obligations and fees borne by producers.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 post-doc research contract - Department of Statistical Sciences (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-06 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-02 Statistica economica

Title of the project:" Statistical challenges in mapping rainfall erosivity in Italy". Estimating rainfall erosivity, i.e. the potential of rainfall to cause soil loss, across Italy poses a challenging statistical problem. High-frequency rainfall data are essential for estimating erosivity, but available records are sparse and heterogeneous in coverage and resolution. This project will address these limitations through the collection, integration and harmonisation of heterogeneous rainfall and environmental data, together with a critical assessment of established methods. item.title: Incarico post-doc: The analysis and evaluation of the cultural politics in Italy (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-26 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-03 Demografia e statistica sociale

The research aims to develop composite economic and social indicators for evaluating a series of cultural policy measures within the Italian context. It intends to carry out a quantitative analysis of the efficiency and effectiveness of public spending measures in the field of culture. For the purposes of this research, the most relevant demographic, economic, and social dimensions identified by the sector's literature will be taken into consideration.

item.description:

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Brand Experience and Consumer Well-being in Digital Environments: Branding Strategies for Shared Value Creation (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-14 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-07 Economia e gestione delle imprese

This research lies at the intersection of brand strategy and consumer behavior in digital experiential contexts, aiming to investigate how brands can pursue their strategic objectives by fully leveraging technological potential while simultaneously protecting and enhancing consumer well-being. By employing mixed (qualitative and quantitative) methodological approaches, the project aims to develop a framework to support the planning of branding strategies in digital environments, exploring the conditions that allow brand goals to be reconciled with the psychological well-being of the consumer.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Models and Methods for Unsupervised Classification of Functional Data with Applications to Dynamic Survival Prediction via Landmarking (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-09 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-01 Statistica

The aim of this project is to propose and develop new methods and models for the unsupervised classification of functional data. These methods will also leverage the functional nature of routinely collected longitudinal patient data to provide more accurate prognostic information for dynamic survival models. Techniques from functional clustering will be extended to account for the sparse and irregular nature of longitudinal data. The extracted information on heterogeneous biomarkers is then integrated into survival models that dynamically estimate survival curves within a landmarking framework. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Multi-source data and non-probability samples (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-09 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-01 Statistica

The statistical literature investigates estimators based on non-probability samples under a set of highly restrictive “standard” conditions, which are rarely met in real-world applications. The project aims to develop new estimators and new methods for assessing sampling error when these standard conditions do not hold. The postdoctoral researcher’s work will involve both theoretical research, focusing on the properties—particularly the asymptotic properties—of the proposed estimators, and simulation-based investigations. Within the project “Peripheries and Vulnerability: The Role of Firms and Universities”, the successful candidate will conduct theoretical and applied research on the contribution of firms and universities to the inclusive development of peripheral and vulnerable territories. The research will examine initiatives and collaborative arrangements aimed at strengthening community participation, access to educational and employment opportunities, and the valorisation of local resources.
